blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Ilocos Norte and Ilocos Sur are among the provinces that have recovered from African swine fever (ASF), marking progress in efforts to revive the local hog industry. The provinces have moved all their ASF-affected areas from red (infected) zones to pink (buffer) or yellow (surveillance) zones, according to the Department of Agriculture’s Bureau of Animal Industry (DA-BAI). The Department of Agriculture’s Bureau of Animal Industry (DA-BAI), through its National ASF Prevention and Control Program, identified the provinces in Bulletin No. 2026-19, which listed areas that had achieved improved classifications as of October.
